title: Subak window placement and remembered tabs, schema version 2
description: Contents of %APPDATA%\mouv\subak\gui.json written by subak-gui since Step 20 (ADR 0051, docs/SUBAK_GUI.md §5): the window's placement, the Terminal shown last and the hidden tabs. No process ids, terminal content or secrets. Version 1 (subak-gui-v1) also held font_size and theme; those moved to config.toml (subak-config-v1), and a version 1 file is migrated once (its values go into config.toml where that file is silent, the old file is backed up). Unknown keys are allowed and preserved by subak-gui when it rewrites the file.

font_size.description: Version 1 only: config.toml appearance.font_size since version 2.

theme.description: Version 1 only: config.toml appearance.theme since version 2.

window.description: The restored (not maximized) outer window rectangle in physical screen pixels at dpi, and whether the window was maximized. A rectangle on no current monitor is ignored.

last_terminal.description: The Terminal shown last, reopened when it still runs (by id, else by name). A hint, never a process.

pinned_terminals.description: #98 T1: pinned Terminals, by id: first in the tab bar, without a hide button, and closing one asks first. Written only when there are any.

hidden_terminals.description: Terminals hidden in the window when it last ran, by id (Step 18). They keep running; the Terminal manager shows them and opening one there shows its tab again.
